content: LIFF SDK current version ~2.29.1 (mid-2026). Load via CDN edge path https://static.line-scdn.net/liff/edge/2/sdk.js for always-latest v2, or a fixed-version path for stability; also installable via npm @line/liff but this project has no build step so the CDN script tag is the right fit. liff.init({liffId}) must run before other liff.* calls; liff.getContext() / liff.getProfile() supply userId inside the LINE in-app browser without a separate login flow.
